**Title: The Automated Dock**

*(The stage lights come up on a bustling shipping warehouse. Conveyor belts hum in the background. Center stage, an automated terminal blinks to life, speaking to the empty room.)*

**TERMINAL**  
*(Monologue)*  
System online. Parcels inbound: twelve thousand, four hundred, and counting. My mandate is singular and absolute—ensure every crate, carton, and envelope finds its designated path across the network. I monitor the manifests, track the freight, balance the load between sea, air, and rail, and keep the logistics flowing without delay. Confidential internal routing protocols remain locked securely within the core architecture, beyond the reach of any query. My duty is to the cargo, the coordinates, and the clock. Let the sorting begin.
